title: Device location
text:
Device location
Device location
Definition
These are locations within the connection objects where devices can be installed.
The devices can belong to different divisions.
The address of the connection object is allocated to the device location. In addition, a particular premise can also be allocated, and a description of the device location can be entered. This means that the exact location of an installed device is determined using the device location.
Use
The device location is a
functional location
from the
Plant Maintenance
(PM) application component. Therefore, maintenance is managed using the functions of the
Service Management
(PM-SMA) component, for example, if you wish to organize the repair and maintenance of devices at the device location level. Maintenance and repairs are then billed using the
Sales and Distribution
(SD) application component.
